subject: english
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word
solution:
The solution is **Dieing.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• The incorrectly spelled word among the options given is "Dieing" (option 3).
 
• The correct spelling for the term meaning the process of ceasing to live is "Dying". 
 
• Therefore **option 3 **is the correct option.
